meaning:
1) to be exalted, be lifted up
1a) (Qal) to be exalted
1b) (Niphal) to lift oneself

elsewhere.note: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of…
The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
